title: New bounds for the support of input-output equations in differential-algebraic systems
summary: Given a polynomial dynamical system $\mathbf{x}'=\mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{u})$ together with an observation function $y=g(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{u})$, where $\mathbf{x}=(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$, $\mathbf{u}=(u_1,\ldots,u_m)$ and $y$ are differential variables, and $\mathbf{f}=(f_1,\ldots,f_n)$, $g$ are polynomials with coefficients in a differential field, we study the problem of determining a minimal polynomial differential equation satisfied by the inputs $\mathbf{u}$ and the output $y$ which follows as a differential consequence of the system.
